settings.appsMenu.add: Add SavePoint to your apps menu
settings.appsMenu.explain: An apps menu entry lists SavePoint with the other programs on this computer, with its icon, so you can open it from your desktop and pin it to your dock. Adding it saves a few small files in your own folder, and you can remove them here at any time.
settings.appsMenu.failed: SavePoint couldn't change your apps menu. Check that you can write to your home folder, then try again.
settings.appsMenu.heading: Apps menu
settings.appsMenu.remove: Remove SavePoint from your apps menu
settings.appsMenu.removeHint: Removing the entry doesn't touch your games or snapshots.
settings.appsMenu.status.added: SavePoint is in your apps menu.
settings.appsMenu.status.foreign: Your apps menu already has a different entry named savepoint. SavePoint leaves it alone.
settings.appsMenu.status.notAdded: SavePoint isn't in your apps menu yet.
settings.appsMenu.status.outOfDate: SavePoint's apps menu entry opens a copy that has moved or been replaced. Update it to open this one.
settings.artwork.onlineHint: SavePoint asks Steam's servers for a game's cover when it isn't on this computer yet. Artwork that's already on this computer is used either way.
settings.beforePlay.heading: Before you play
settings.beforePlay.skip: Skip the check before playing when only your saves change
settings.beforePlay.skipHint: A change to the game version or mods always shows the check.
settings.clearAll.body: Deletes every snapshot and all of SavePoint's settings, so you can't go back to any earlier version, mods or saves. Your game folders stay exactly as they are now.
settings.clearAll.dialog.intro: SavePoint deletes every snapshot and setting it keeps and starts over as if new. You can't go back to any earlier version, mods or saves afterwards. This can't be undone.
settings.clearAll.dialog.itemGames: {games, plural, one {# game} other {# games}} and {profiles, plural, one {# profile} other {# profiles}}, with all their snapshots
settings.clearAll.dialog.itemSettings: SavePoint's settings and game list, in {path}
settings.clearAll.dialog.markers: SavePoint only removes the small file it added to {count, plural, one {# game folder} other {# game folders}} to recognize {count, plural, one {it} other {them}}.
settings.clearAll.dialog.stays: Your game folders and everything in them stay exactly as they are.
settings.clearAll.dialog.title: Remove all SavePoint data?
settings.clearAll.heading: Remove all SavePoint data
settings.clearAll.leftBehindBody: SavePoint removed the rest. You can delete these by hand.

settings.session.askHint: When this is off, SavePoint keeps nothing after you play. It asks about your new changes before the next switch instead.

settings.storage.heading: Where SavePoint keeps your snapshots
settings.storage.leftBehindBody: SavePoint couldn't remove them. You can delete these by hand.
settings.storage.leftBehindTitle: Your snapshots moved, but some old files are still in the old folder
settings.storage.moveMessage: SavePoint will copy {size} ({count, plural, one {{files} file} other {{files} files}}) to {destination} and check every file. Once that is done, SavePoint removes its old copy from the current folder.
settings.storage.optimizeConfirm.confirm: Delete {count, plural, one {# snapshot} other {# snapshots}} and free up space
settings.storage.optimizeConfirm.message: Freeing up space also deletes {count, plural, one {# recently removed snapshot} other {# recently removed snapshots}} for good. {count, plural, one {It is} other {They are}} no longer part of any profile, and you can't bring {count, plural, one {it} other {them}} back afterward.
settings.storage.optimizeConfirm.title: Free up space?
settings.storage.optimizeLastRun: Clears out snapshots no profile uses anymore, such as a deleted profile's, and deletes recently removed snapshots for good. SavePoint also tidies up by itself after you delete a profile and when snapshots pile up, and that never deletes recently removed snapshots. You last freed up space on {date}.
settings.storage.optimizeNeverRun: Clears out snapshots no profile uses anymore, such as a deleted profile's, and deletes recently removed snapshots for good. SavePoint also tidies up by itself after you delete a profile and when snapshots pile up, and that never deletes recently removed snapshots. You haven't freed up space yet.
